summary: Ilocos Norte 2nd District representative with 196 principal-authored bills. Only two surfaced under rubric topics: an amendment to the Motor Vehicle User's Charge Act and a co-authored national minimum wage. No dimension has two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Large bill portfolio, but the review surfaced only two rubric-relevant items; the rest were not individually reviewed.
